prompt: A short piano passage keeps tripping you up when you play it at full speed. Which practice technique is most likely to fix it?

options.text: Play the whole piece even faster to force your fingers to learn
Play just that passage slowly with a steady beat, speeding up gradually only when it is accurate
Avoid the passage and spend the time on the easy parts
Play the passage once a day at full speed and hope it improves

explanation: Slow, accurate repetitions of just the difficult passage build the correct movement first; adding speed gradually then keeps the accuracy instead of rehearsing the same mistake faster.
